documentation.content:
A Cloud Run Job execution of world-genre-pipeline finished with result=failed.

This is the FAST alarm: it fires within ~10 minutes of a run that started and then broke. It says nothing about a run that never started - see the companion policy 'has not completed in 30h' for that.

First move: gcloud logging read "resource.type=cloud_run_job AND resource.labels.job_name=world-genre-pipeline AND severity>=ERROR" --freshness=2h --limit=20 --format="value(textPayload)"

Exit code 1 means a stage raised or the gate failed on the data - deterministic, do not just retry. Exit code 2 means a check could not execute - transient, retry is reasonable. The publish is skipped either way, so the API keeps serving the previous run's payloads: this is a stale-data incident, not an outage.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name = "world-genre-pipeline" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND metric.labels.result = "failed"
